candidate_sentence_map.S1: For the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, A/S SAF Tehnika reported consolidated net revenue of EUR 25.99 million, representing a 4 percent decrease from EUR 27.09 million in the prior year.

candidate_sentence_map.S3: Despite the revenue decline, the group posted a net loss of EUR 643 thousand, a substantial improvement compared to the EUR 2.37 million loss in the previous year.

candidate_sentence_map.S5: The reduction in losses was primarily driven by lower cost of goods sold and controlled operating expenditures, which together brought the operating loss down to EUR 1.29 million from EUR 3.22 million a year earlier.

candidate_sentence_map.S11: Import duties on microwave equipment into the US remain unchanged, though the Aranet product line faces a 15 percent tariff.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: To mitigate supply chain and customs risks, the group established a Canadian subsidiary during the reporting period.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Operational adjustments continued throughout the year, with inventory levels stabilizing after multi-year stockpiling aimed at securing component availability.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Slow-moving inventory decreased by EUR 1.24 million compared to the prior year-end.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Cash reserves strengthened significantly, rising by EUR 2.6 million to EUR 4.81 million, supported by positive operating cash flow and an unused EUR 4.95 million credit facility with Luminor Bank.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company invested EUR 812 thousand in research and development, IT infrastructure, equipment, and facility upgrades, while also securing EUR 570 thousand in project co-financing.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Management characterized the current net loss as temporary and maintains a cautious but positive outlook, emphasizing continued focus on niche wireless data transmission technologies and IoT environmental monitoring solutions without providing forward-looking commercial projections.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Pasaules elektronikas pakalpojumu tirgu joprojām ietekmē ASV un Ķīnas tirdzniecības attiecību saspīlējums, taču šobrīd tas neizraisa būtisku negatīvu ietekmi uz Grupas pārdošanas apjomiem.

factual_claims.claim: Import duties on microwave equipment into the US remain unchanged, though the Aranet product line faces a 15 percent tariff.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ievedmuita mikroviļņu iekārtām, kas tiek importētas ASV no Eiropas Savienības, nemainās, savukārt Aranet produktu grupai tā noteikta 15% apmērā.

factual_claims.claim: To mitigate supply chain and customs risks, the group established a Canadian subsidiary during the reporting period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Lai mazinātu iespējamos ar piegādes ķēdēm un muitas izmaksām saistītos riskus, pārskata gadā tika dibināta Grupas filiāle Kanādā.

factual_claims.claim: Operational adjustments continued throughout the year, with inventory levels stabilizing after multi-year stockpiling aimed at securing component availability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Lai nodrošinātu pasūtījumu izpildi ierastajos termiņos, uzņēmums regulāri pārskatīja iepirkumu apjomus un piegādes grafikus, veidojot materiālu rezerves. ... Lēnas aprites krājumu kopējais apjoms ... samazinājies par 1,24 miljoniem EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Slow-moving inventory decreased by EUR 1.24 million compared to the prior year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Lēnas aprites krājumu kopējais apjoms, salīdzinot ar iepriekšējā finanšu gada beigām, samazinājies par 1,24 miljoniem EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Cash reserves strengthened significantly, rising by EUR 2.6 million to EUR 4.81 million, supported by positive operating cash flow and an unused EUR 4.95 million credit facility with Luminor Bank.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Grupas naudas līdzekļu atlikums uz gada beigām bija 4.81 miljons EUR, kas ir par 2.6 miljoniem EUR vairāk kā iepriekšējā pārskata gada beigās. ... Mātes sabiedrība turpināja kredītlīnijas līgumu ar Luminor Bank AS par kopējo summu EUR 4.95 miljoni EUR, pārskata perioda beigās kredītlīnijas nebija izmantota.

factual_claims.claim: The company invested EUR 812 thousand in research and development, IT infrastructure, equipment, and facility upgrades, while also securing EUR 570 thousand in project co-financing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Pārskata gadā Grupa investēja 812 tūkstošu EUR IT infrastruktūras, ražošanas un pētniecības iekārtu, programmatūras un licenču iegādē, kā arī produktu sertifikācijā un telpu renovācijā. ... Pārskata periodā Grupas produktu izstrādes projektiem tika saņemts līdzfinansējums no kompetences centra “LEO Pētījumu centrs” SIA 570 tūkstošu EUR apjomā.

factual_claims.claim: Management characterized the current net loss as temporary and maintains a cautious but positive outlook, emphasizing continued focus on niche wireless data transmission technologies and IoT environmental monitoring solutions without providing forward-looking commercial projections.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Grupas vadība vērtē pārskata gada zaudējumu situāciju kā pārejošu ... Mātes sabiedrības Valde atturas izteikt jebkādus paziņojumus par nākotnes pārdošanas apjomiem un finanšu rezultātiem.
